raw_text: Verified: RSF has taken control of Khartoum International Airport. SAF airstrikes reported targeting RSF positions in south Khartoum. Multiple fires visible across the city skyline. Foreign embassies issuing shelter-in-place advisories. This appears to be a coordinated RSF operation to seize key infrastructure before SAF could respond.
clean_text: RSF controls Khartoum airport. SAF airstrikes on RSF in south Khartoum. Fires across city. Foreign embassies issuing shelter advisories. Coordinated RSF infrastructure seizure.
